title: Strategic Student Program: Cross-Domain Manufacturing Systems Engineering Intern  (T&I, Spring 2027)
description: Job Family: Software Req ID: 526362 Siemens Industry Software Inc. Strategic Student Program (SSP) Discover your career with us at Siemens Industry Software! We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential. We’re currently recruiting students for our {1st or 2nd semester of Senior year, or graduate level} Strategic Student Program. Our intern positions will allow you to find a career path that most inspires you. Here, you will apply your education to solve real-world problems, and turn theory into practice. At Siemens, our goal is to empower our students to become the next leaders of our company. Baseline Requirements: Currently enrolled as a university {Senior, Master’s or PhD candidate} student Minimum 3.0 GPA Authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship by the company Graduating 2028, or later Detroit, MI; Wilsonville, OR; possible remote depending on degree level being pursued Perks: Paid volunteer time off Employee discounts at our top customer sites Networking with our global leaders Mentorship from senior engineers Individual career development planning Professional and technical workshops Energetic student community Leadership opportunities Potential for full time offers after university graduation and completion of the program Cross-Domain EDA/CAE/M anufacturing Systems Engineering Intern About the Team The Cross Product Solution Management (CPSM) team researches and develops innovative solutions that demonstrate how modern engineering disciplines work together across Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), robotics, mechatronics, semiconductor manufacturing, electronics, AI, and software engineering. This internship offers the opportunity to contribute to a "silicon-to-rack" engineering initiative that showcases the integration of EDA, PLM, and AI-enabled workflows across the entire product development lifecycle. What You'll Do As an intern, you will work with senior engineers and technical specialists to: Research and evaluate emerging semiconductor engineering technologies (3D IC) and workflows Develop software prototypes, automation tools, and proof-of-concept solutions Semiconductor, PCB, and system-level design, validation,and implementation concepts Document technical findings through white papers, tutorials, and technical guides Investigate AI-assisted engineering and documentation workflows Learn and utilize industry-leading EDA and PLM tools Help define and demonstrate an end-to-end engineering digital thread from silicon design through system deployment Areas of Exposure Depending on project assignments, interns may gain experience in: Semiconductor and IC design and CAE methodologies 3D-IC and advanced packaging concepts Mechanical design integration Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Technical documentation and workflow development Packaging and manufacturing concepts Required Qualifications Pursuing a Bachelor's, Masters, or Ph.D. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or related STEM field Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to learn quickly and work independently Self-motivated, curious, and adaptable Preferred Qualifications Semiconductorpackaging design and implementation research emphasis or exposure Interest in CAE, EDA, PLM, automation, or AI technologies Familiarity with Linux or scripting environments Previous internship, co-op, or project experience a plus Position Objective Contribute to the research, development, and documentation of a reference "silicon-to-rack" product development workflow demonstrating how modern CAE, EDA, PLM, and AI technologies connect semiconductor design and packaging, system design, mechanical engineering, and lifecycle management into a unified engineering ecosystem. The initiative spans IC design, packaging, PCB, mechanical, and PLM domains within an integrated engineering workflow. The hourly range for this position is $18.00 to $50.00. Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to employees. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate’s work location, as well as degree type and relevant education. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: www.benefitsquickstart.com . In addition, this position is eligible for time off in accordance with Company policies, including paid sick leave and paid volunteer time off. 18 50 Organization: Digital Industries Job Type: Full-Time temporary Category: Internal Services

description: AI/ML Developer Intern This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. Job Description: The AI/ML Developer Intern builds from the ground up to meet the needs of mission-critical applications and is always looking for innovative approaches to deliver end-to-end technical solutions to solve customer problems. Brings technical thinking to break down complex data and to engineer new ideas and methods for solving, prototyping, designing, and implementing cloud-based solutions. Collaborates with project managers and development partners to ensure effective and efficient delivery, deployment, operation, monitoring, and support of AI/ML models. The AI/ML Developer provides business value expertise to drive the development of innovative service offerings that enrich HPE's AI/ML services portfolio across multiple systems, platforms, and applications. Responsibilities: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and implement AI/ML solutions tailored to meet business needs. Works with domain experts to identify and formalize machine learning problems for wireless and wired network diagnostics, root causing, problem remediation, and optimization Design, implement, and validate machine learning algorithms on big data Guide and oversee deployment of implemented machine learning solutions and monitor their operation Use Agentic AI to solve networking problems Identifies, debugs and creates solutions for issues with code and integration into application architecture Develops and executes comprehensive test plans for features adhering to performance, scale, usability, and security requirements. Deploy AI/ML systems and applications code using continuous integration/deployment pipelines Contributes towards innovation and integration of new technologies into projects Analyzes science, engineering, business, and other data processing problems to develop and implement solutions to complex application problems, system administration issues, or networking Education & Experience required: Working towards a Bachelor's and/or Master's/PhD degree with a focus in Computer science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics or other related fields (Master’s degree candidates strongly preferred) Familiarity with and understanding of design for software systems Proficient Python coder (PySpark, Scikit-learn), experience with software engineering best practices A basic understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) Strong background in statistical and machine learning techniques such as anomaly detection, clustering and ranking of events, time series analysis, event stream mining, hypothesis testing, causal inference, and deep learning Great at communicating concepts and results; strong data visualization skills Relevant industry experience in data science and machine learning Experience with online learning algorithms, reinforcement learning, semi-supervised learning, or mixed time-series/event streams Familiarity with GenAI and large language models (LLMs). Agentic AI is a plus Accessibility HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. title: Strategic Student Program: Simulation Engineering Internship (Spring 2027, SIM)
description: Job Family: Software Req ID: 520106 Siemens Digital Industries Software Strategic Student Program (SSP) Discover your career with us at Siemens Digital Industries Software! We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential. We’re currently recruiting co-ops and interns for our Spring 2027 Strategic Student Program . Our opportunities will allow you to find a career path that most inspires you. Here, you will apply your education to solve real-world problems and turn theory into practice. At Siemens, our goal is to empower our students to become the next leaders of our company. Baseline Program Requirements: Currently enrolled as an undergraduate student at an accredited university Legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship by the company A minimum 3.0 GPA Perks: Employee discounts at our top customer sites Networking with our global leaders Mentorship from senior employees Individual career development planning Professional and technical workshops Paid volunteer time off Energetic student community Leadership opportunities Potential for full-time offers after university graduation and completion of the program Position Overview: We are seeking a motivated Structural Dynamics & Vibro-Acoustic Simulation Engineering Intern / Co-op student currently pursuing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mechanics, or a related field to support the development of advanced modeling strategies for structural dynamics applications and their integration with Statistical Energy Analysis (SEA) methodologies. The selected candidate will work on the development and validation of analytical and semi-analytical modeling strategies for structural dynamics and vibro-acoustic applications, with emphasis on complex built-up structures such as multilayer composite and laminate visco-elastic panels. The candidate will perform validation of the developed methodologies and simulation strategies using finite element and boundary element analysis (FEA/BEA) tools. The role includes vibro-acoustic modeling, fluid-structure interaction studies, and analysis of acoustic performance metrics such as transmission loss and near-field acoustic prediction using concepts related to panel directivity and acoustic radiation behavior. The position offers hands-on experience in structural dynamics, vibro-acoustics, numerical simulation, and engineering software development. The candidate will collaborate closely on research and development activities involving finite element modeling, dynamic response analysis, and the validation of new simulation and modeling approaches. Key Responsibilities: Structural Dynamics & Simulation Focus Develop and evaluate modeling strategies for structural dynamics applications with relevance to Statistical Energy Analysis (SEA). Build, modify, and analyze finite element models using commercial solvers such as Nastran or OptiStruct. Create and refine pre-processing and meshing workflows using tools such as Femap or HyperMesh. Perform dynamic analyses including modal, frequency response, and vibro-acoustic simulations. Validate developed methodologies through finite element and boundary element simulations and comparison of numerical results. Support the automation of simulation workflows and data processing using programming and scripting tools. Collaborate on the development of custom simulation utilities and computational tools using languages such as Python, C++, FORTRAN, or Compose. Document methodologies, simulation procedures, and technical findings clearly and professionally. Requirements: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mechanics, Engineering Physics, or a related field. Open to undergraduate and graduate students. Comfortable working in a fully remote environment in the US. Strong background in structural dynamics, vibrations, or statistical Energy Analysis. Familiarity with finite element simulation workflows and CAE tools such as: Nastran OptiStruct Simcenter Femap HyperMesh or similar software Understanding of modal analysis, dynamic response analysis, vibro-acoustic simulation concepts, and fluid-structure interaction fundamentals. Programming experience in one or more of the following languages: Python C++ FORTRAN Compose MATLAB or similar scripting environments Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a research and development environment. Good written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications: Exposure to Statistical Energy Analysis (SEA) or vibro-acoustic analysis methods. Experience interpreting and validating structural dynamic and vibro-acoustic simulation results. Experience with programming, scripting and simulation automation. #LI-PLM #LI-Remote $18 $50 Organization: Digital Industries Job Type: Part-time temporary Category: Internal Services
